name: BTC Futures Basis: Cash-and-Carry Spread Analysis
description: Annualized BTC CME futures basis (cash-and-carry spread) vs spot. Shows current basis level, 252-day z-score and percentile rank for historical context, average basis by Fed Funds regime (high vs low rates), and flags extreme basis events (>25% or <2%). Formula: (Futures - Spot) / Spot × 365 / DTE.
source:
# BTC CME Futures Basis: Cash-and-Carry Spread Analysis
# Annualized basis = (Futures - Spot) / Spot x 365 / DTE
# Compares current basis to history via z-score and percentile rank
# Buckets by Fed Funds regime to show rate-sensitivity

# --- Data ---
# CME Bitcoin futures (primary asset) — NoAdjustment for raw price levels
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

futures_price = cont.c
dte = cont.dte

# BTC spot price (Coinbase)
spot_raw = crypto_pairs(ticker='BTCUSD')()
spot_price = ffill(spot_raw.c)

# Fed Funds rate for regime bucketing
ff_raw = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
fed_funds = ffill(ff_raw.result)

# --- Basis Calculation ---
# Guard: DTE must be > 5 to avoid annualization blow-up near expiry
# Guard: both prices must be valid
valid_data = is_valid(futures_price) and is_valid(spot_price) and is_valid(dte) and dte > 5 and spot_price > 0

raw_basis = where(valid_data, (futures_price - spot_price) / spot_price)
annualized_basis = where(valid_data, raw_basis * (365.0 / dte))

# --- Historical Context ---
# 252-day rolling z-score: how extreme is current basis vs trailing year?
basis_z = zscore(window=252)(annualized_basis)

# 252-day percentile rank: where does current sit in trailing distribution? (0-100)
basis_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(annualized_basis)

# 90-day SMA for trend context on the line chart
basis_sma90 = ma(period=90, type=MAType.sma)(annualized_basis)

# --- Regime Bucketing ---
# Fed Funds > 3% = "High Rates", <= 3% = "Low Rates"
# Filter basis by regime for bar chart comparison
basis_high_rates = where(is_valid(fed_funds) and fed_funds > 3.0, annualized_basis)
basis_low_rates = where(is_valid(fed_funds) and fed_funds <= 3.0, annualized_basis)

# --- Event Detection: Extreme Basis ---
# Rich basis (>25%) or cheap basis (<2%) — these are the moments that matter
is_rich = is_valid(annualized_basis) and annualized_basis > 0.25
is_cheap = is_valid(annualized_basis) and annualized_basis < 0.02
is_extreme = is_rich or is_cheap

extreme_label = conditional_select(is_rich, "Rich (>25%)", is_cheap, "Cheap (<2%)", "Normal")
extreme_basis_pct = where(is_extreme, annualized_basis)
extreme_z = where(is_extreme, basis_z)

# --- Timestamps ---
ts = index().value

# --- Output 1: Annualized Basis Over Time (CONTEXT) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Is the BTC Carry Trade Still Paying?',
    category='BTC Basis',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Basis',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Annualized Basis', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='90d Moving Avg', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Zero'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.10, color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='10% (Attractive)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.25, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='25% (Extreme)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(color=Color.Green, opacity=0.05, label='Positive Carry', from=0.0, to=1.0),
        PlotBand(color=Color.Red, opacity=0.05, label='Negative Carry', from=-0.5, to=0.0)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(annualized_basis, basis_sma90))

# --- Output 2: Basis by Fed Funds Regime (PUNCHLINE) ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Median Basis: High vs Low Rate Environments',
    category='BTC Basis',
    x_axis_label='Fed Funds Regime',
    y_axis_label='Median Annualized Basis',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High Rates (>3%)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low Rates (<=3%)', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(basis_high_rates, basis_low_rates))

# --- Output 3: Summary Stats (REFERENCE) ---
# Row 0 = Current (Last), Row 1 = Historical median/extremes, Row 2 = Averages
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='BTC Basis',
    order=3,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BTC Basis: Where Are We Now?',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Current', 'Historical Median', 'Historical Extreme'],
        col_headers=['Basis (Ann.)', 'Z-Score (1Y)', 'Percentile (1Y)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0)
        ]
    )
)(annualized_basis, basis_z, basis_pctrank, annualized_basis, basis_z, basis_pctrank, annualized_basis, basis_z, basis_pctrank)

# --- Event Markers: Extreme Basis Events ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Extreme Basis Event',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Annualized Basis', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score (1Y)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(extreme_label, extreme_basis_pct, extreme_z, is_extreme)
